settings.headline: BUILD THE NETWORK
settings.tagline: HOW FAR CAN YOUR PARTNERSHIP TAKE THE GOSPEL?
settings.intro: Every station carries a message. Every transmission creates an opportunity. Every partnership can help take the Gospel further.
settings.reveal_title: YOU’VE SEEN THE POSSIBILITIES. NOW, LET’S MAKE IT A REALITY.
settings.reveal_text: Your partnership can help expand the network and take the message into more communities.
settings.methodology: All seeded stations and coverage groups are illustrative. Radius rings show approximate surface distances, not measured RF coverage. Territories and languages are deduplicated by unique IDs; audience is summed once per non-overlapping coverage unit only when every unit has an estimate. Audience is unavailable in this sample. Daily hours sum configured station schedules; monthly hours use 30 days. The network footprint sums approved non-overlapping coverage areas and remains zero until configured. None of these results is evidence of actual reach.
